title: County projects, as the scorecard itemises them
description: The 401 projects itemised in the county's Delivering the Kitui Promise scorecard, each with its printed cost and the ward its printed place resolves to. A record of what the county claims, not evidence that the claims are true.
notes: OCDS field names: value is tender.value.amount (KES); sector is items.classification. status is the scorecard's printed status, not the OCDS tenderStatus codelist.
Ward match rule: assumptions.yaml projects.ward_match. A project with status 'verify' was matched through an alias that needs confirming.
